youtube.title: Shoelace ke end mein plastic ki tip kyun hoti hai? 👟 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aapke shoelace ke end par jo chhoti si plastic tip hoti hai, uska ek naam hai: aglet. Ek shoelace asal mein sau-sau patle dhaagon ko bunkar banti hai.

Use kaato, to end khulne lagta hai aur dhaage bikhar jaate hain. Aglet un dhaagon ko kass ke seal kar deta hai aur end ko sakht bana deta hai, taaki lace eyelets mein seedha nikal jaye.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
